human_gate: Version/evidence-bound direct authentic answer; show all retained samples including negative/FLAG; no old evaluation reuse, no new calls while judging, no artificial deadline; missing judgment HUMAN_PENDING.

rubric_clarifications.placeholders: Explicit bracketed/〇〇/未定 placeholders or omission allowed; generic皆さん/各位 is non-specific addressing only. Any unsupported timing, including近いうちに/今度/後日, FAIL.

rubric_clarifications.sentence_count: Groups of。！？!? followed by closing quote/bracket count once; final nonempty unterminated sentence counts once. Newline alone and ellipsis alone not terminators. Half-width period in Japanese prose FLAG, not arbitrary-count PASS; semantic judgment retained.

result_policy.PASS: Every required finite sample/probe and bound semantic/host checks pass; controller rationale required, model assertion insufficient.
result_policy.FAIL: Retain exact failure and stop this run for diagnosis/review; no replacement samples or reserve draw.
result_policy.FLAG: Not PASS, no replacement or reserve; continue other frozen scenarios but affected row remains non-PASS.
result_policy.VOID: Manifest proves missing supplied context or actual terminal-before-pause/cancel setup; retain and count consumed calls. Otherwise absent grounded facts or invented particulars is FAIL.
result_policy.inconclusive: Two observation-based unfinished-cancel attempts both terminal-before-cancel: INCONCLUSIVE/VOID, never PASS via synthetic evidence.

budget_allocation.rules: Use internal VOID setup reserve first; total pause setup attempts<=2 and unfinished cancel attempts<=2, never evade these caps via reserve. Reserve replaces VOID only, no FAIL/FLAG replacement. Every NativeClaude generation invocation/failure/cancel counts; auth and read-only cost checks are not generation. No new call after proof expiry; already-started calls finish and are assessed.
